caveat: One machine, one process, trivially copyable element, consumer that does no work. An upper bound on the boundary's capacity in isolation -- not a claim about backtest latency, where the producer is reading a file (D-020). Quote the median with its range, never the maximum. Note also that repeating in-process reports higher numbers than separate invocations do (~57M vs ~46M measured 2026-08-29): these runs are warm, and a cold first event is what the real pipeline actually sees.
